integrity: Equations are proved for every positive Dirichlet parameter and interior threshold; exact-rational and numerical checks are finite corroboration. An earlier equivalent expression might exist in older spacing literature.
scientific_limitations: Nonexchangeable total exceedance counts are not classified; limiting zero covariance gives independence only of the joint Gaussian limit; no test-power claim or literature-wide proof of priority.
title: A sharp Greenwood–exceedance covariance crossover for Dirichlet compositions
